title: UMG Gate Expression Schema
description: Compound trigger gate expressions for NeoStack activation. Supports any, all, not, threshold, priority, and fallback operators. Gate priority controls activation order. Vertical hierarchy controls content dominance.

GateCondition.description: A single condition within a gate expression.

signal.description: Context signal name. Binary: present or absent in active_context.signals.

gate_weight.description: Weight contribution to threshold score when this signal is matched. Only meaningful for threshold operator gates. Non-threshold gates ignore this value.

GateExpression.description: A compound gate expression attached to a NeoStack.

gate_id.description: Unique identifier for this gate. Convention: GATE_{DESCRIPTOR} in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

operator.description: Gate evaluation operator. See operator definitions below.

conditions.description: Conditions evaluated by this gate. Required for: any, all, not, threshold. Omit for: priority, fallback.

threshold.description: Required score for threshold operator. Score = sum of gate_weight values for matched conditions. Gate fires when score >= threshold.

priority.description: Activation priority. Higher value = activates first when multiple gates fire. Does NOT override vertical hierarchy for content conflicts.

fallback.description: When true, this gate fires only when no other gate in the sleeve has activated a NeoStack. Provides default cognitive mode.

negated_conditions.description: Signal names that must be ABSENT for this gate to fire. Used by not operator and as optional constraint on other operators.

target_stack_id.description: ID of the NeoStack this gate controls. Set by the resolver from sleeve structure.

description.description: Human-readable description of this gate's intent.

then.description: Threshold gates require threshold value and at least one condition with gate_weight.
Not gates require at least one negated_condition.

GateEvaluationResult.description: Output of evaluateGates() pass for a single gate. Appended to route_trace and gate_evaluations in RuntimeSpec.

score.description: Computed weighted score. Populated for threshold gates only.

threshold.description: Required threshold. Populated for threshold gates only.

matched_conditions.description: Signal names that were present and contributed to gate match.

failed_conditions.description: Signal names that were required but absent.

result.description: Activation outcome for the target NeoStack.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. Examples: 'All conditions matched.', 'Threshold score 0.75 met required 0.75.', 'No gate matched — fallback activated.'

description: Gate expression object for use in NeoStack definition. Embed directly in sleeve JSON.

examples.description: Activates if any technical signal is present.
Fires when technical + governance signals together score >= 0.75.
Activates on technical request only when no creative signal is present.
Activates only when all release-preparation signals are present.
Always-on governance when no other gate fires. Default cognitive mode.

operatorDefinitions.any: Fires if at least one condition signal is present in active_context.signals.
operatorDefinitions.all: Fires only if every condition signal is present in active_context.signals.
operatorDefinitions.not: Fires only if all negated_conditions are absent. May also require conditions to be present.
operatorDefinitions.threshold: Fires when the weighted sum of matched condition gate_weights >= threshold. Score = sum of gate_weight for each matched signal.
operatorDefinitions.priority: Activates in explicit priority order. Does not evaluate conditions — acts as a ranking modifier on gates that do.
operatorDefinitions.fallback: Fires when no other gate in the sleeve has resulted in an activated NeoStack. Provides default behavior.

scoringModel.signalPresence: binary — a signal is either in active_context.signals or it is not
scoringModel.weightOwnership: gate owns the weight — same signal can have different gate_weight in different gates
scoringModel.scoreFormula: score = sum of gate_weight for all matched conditions
scoringModel.maxScore: sum of all gate_weight values. Should equal 1.0 for well-formed threshold gates.
scoringModel.partialActivation: not supported in v0.2 — gate either fires or is suppressed
